features.name: Redirections
features.description: Implement all POSIX redirections: >, >>, <, >&, N>&M, N<&M. Handle heredocs with delimiter quoting rules.

features.name: Core builtins
features.description: Implement essential builtins that must run in shell process: cd, export, unset, exit, source/., echo, pwd, type, alias, unalias.

features.name: Job control
features.description: Process groups, foreground/background jobs, signal handling (SIGCHLD, SIGINT, SIGTSTP, SIGCONT), job table, fg/bg/jobs/wait builtins.

features.name: OSC 2337 protocol emitter
features.description: Emit custom escape sequences to communicate with colony-terminal: Agent status, Widget requests, Output metadata, Memory operations.

features.name: Tuple space (in-process)
features.description: Linda-style tuple space with out/in/rd/inp/rdp primitives using scc::HashMap and parking_lot for synchronization.

features.name: Tuple space (cross-process IPC)
features.description: Extend tuple space to work across processes via ipc-channel from Servo project.

features.name: Memory substrate (SQLite)
features.description: SQLite schema for memory metadata: scope, project, timestamps, importance, validity. CRUD operations with proper indexing.

features.name: Memory substrate (LanceDB vectors)
features.description: Vector embeddings via LanceDB + fastembed (all-MiniLM-L6-v2). Semantic search over memories with hybrid text+vector queries.

features.name: Agent NL detection and routing
features.description: Detect natural language input (# or ? prefix, failed parse heuristics) and route to LLM instead of shell execution.
